title: Device diagnostics (private-profile extension)
description: Response of GET /device-diagnostics/v0/{assetId}. A private-profile extension, not CAMARA Device Location.

diagnostics.description: Core vocabulary fields at the top; everything else under vendorSpecific. See docs/profile-extensions.md.

lastCommunicationTime.description: omlox timestamp_generated: when the device last communicated with its source, RFC 3339 UTC

vendorSpecific.description: Values an integrator mapped that this profile does not define. Keys are chosen by whoever wrote the vendor schema, are not comparable across vendors, and are carried as authored. Non-authoritative.
